body:
Source: GitHub issue #797 (bug, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ de8a130a: plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs:1883 `const grewOrShrank = postSize !== size;` feeds `truncated: truncatedByBytes || shortRead || grewOrShrank` (:1887). `truncated: true` reaches `evaluateHandoffPreToolUse` as `scanTruncated` (:2362, :2539) and `@adlc/context-handoff`'s adapter denies with `incomplete_scan_lower_bound` whenever depth < HANDOFF_DEPTH (30). Growth is not incompleteness: when `length === size` the worker read the whole file from byte 0, so a later append cannot hide an earlier record; only a shrink can. Measured by the reporter: with an external appender every 2 ms, 24 of 131 `boundedHandoffRead` calls on a 1 KB file fully read from byte 0 returned `truncated: true`. Note: the context-handoff gate ships DISCONNECTED in 1.11.x (`hooks.json` wires no handoff verb — docs/integrations/claude-code.md line ~144, issue #966), so this is latent today; the code is intact, tested, and will be reconnected, so the fix is still owed.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Plugin `plugins/adlc-claude-code` (no package.json — not an npm workspace): hooks/adlc-hook.mjs (one large module; `boundedHandoffRead(path, { maxBytes, deadlineMs })` at ~:1833 spawns hooks/tail-read-worker.mjs and interprets its header frame `{ ok, size, postSize, readSoFar }`; `observeHandoffSignals` at ~:1782 threads `truncated`), hooks/tail-read-worker.mjs (reports `postSize` from an fstat after the read, :81-105 — its frame contract is unchanged by this ticket), hooks/test/bounded-handoff-read.test.mjs (existing coverage: within-budget read not truncated, maxBytes window truncates, deadline, unopenable → null, worker exit code, size read fresh — it never exercises growth, so it does not pin the defect; leave it alone and put new cases in the new file). Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` from the worktree root; root runner segment `claude-code hooks`. Active rails from other tickets already freeze several hooks/test/*.test.mjs files; none is one this fix needs.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. The header-to-outcome mapping becomes ONE exported pure function in hooks/adlc-hook.mjs, `readOutcomeFromHeader({ size, postSize, readSoFar }, maxBytes)`, returning `{ length, truncatedByBytes, shortRead, shrank, truncated }` where `length = min(size, maxBytes)`, `truncatedByBytes = length < size`, `shortRead = readSoFar < length`, `shrank = postSize < size`, and `truncated = truncatedByBytes || shortRead || shrank`. `boundedHandoffRead` calls it; the `grewOrShrank` term is gone. Growth (`postSize > size`) after a complete read is NOT truncation.
2. Everything else in `boundedHandoffRead` is unchanged: the SIGKILL/ETIMEDOUT path still returns `{ size: 0, text: '', truncated: true }`; a non-zero worker exit, a garbled header, a non-finite field, or a frame whose byte count disagrees with `readSoFar` still returns null; the text returned is still the worker's bytes.
3. Documentation: docs/integrations/claude-code.md, in the section `### Recovering from a handoff deny` (~line 269), gains a short paragraph naming the `incomplete_scan_lower_bound` deny reason: it fires when the transcript scan did not reach start-of-file (the transcript exceeds the 8 MiB scan budget, the scan hit its wall-clock budget, or the file shrank mid-read) while the observed tool-call depth is still below 30, and it clears once depth reaches 30 or in a fresh session. State plainly that transcript growth during a complete read no longer triggers it. Hand-edit only; nothing is generated here.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `readOutcomeFromHeader({size: 1024, postSize: 4096, readSoFar: 1024}, 8 MiB)` → `truncated: false, shrank: false` (growth after a full read). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-read-growth.test.mjs`
- AC2 Shrink → `truncated: true, shrank: true`; short read (`readSoFar < length`) → `truncated: true`; windowed read (`size > maxBytes`) → `truncatedByBytes: true, truncated: true` even when `postSize === size`. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-read-growth.test.mjs`
- AC3 End to end through the real worker: a file appended to AFTER the worker has read it but BEFORE it reports (drive this deterministically — for example a fixture path the test keeps appending to from a parallel child while calling `boundedHandoffRead` in a loop until at least one frame shows `postSize > size`, asserting every such frame returned `truncated: false`; or any other deterministic construction the lane documents in the PR body) is reported complete. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-read-growth.test.mjs`
- AC4 `readOutcomeFromHeader` is pure: same inputs → deep-equal outputs, input object not mutated. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-read-growth.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing hook suite green and untouched, including hooks/test/bounded-handoff-read.test.mjs. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Docs updated. verify: `grep -c "incomplete_scan_lower_bound" docs/integrations/claude-code.md` (>= 1)
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: the >8 MiB windowed-read deny policy itself (it lives in packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs, a different package — file a follow-up, do not fold in), reconnecting the handoff verb in hooks.json (#966), hooks/tail-read-worker.mjs, and any other hook.
title: adlc-claude-code: a transcript that grows during a complete handoff read is not an incomplete scan
